description: This Java class demonstrates the use of a SeekBar widget in an Android application, including event handling for user interactions.

classes.name: SeekBar1
classes.description: An Activity demonstrating how to implement and handle events for a SeekBar widget.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI elements and event listeners.

methods.name: onProgressChanged
methods.description: Updates the progress TextView when the SeekBar progress changes.

methods.name: onStartTrackingTouch
methods.description: Updates the tracking TextView when user starts dragging the SeekBar.

methods.name: onStopTrackingTouch
methods.description: Updates the tracking TextView when user stops dragging the SeekBar.
